data.body: **[P2] Preserve derived callback names before deferred export.** `waitForCallback("name", ...)` deliberately does not checkpoint the inner `<name>-callback` name; it is backfilled only during handler traversal. If that branch is skipped before suspension, this stores the raw update with no name, `onInvocationEnd` exports it as `CALLBACK`, and the later replay is skipped, so the terminal span never receives its expected name. Merge lifecycle metadata or derive the name from the parent `WaitForCallback` context in `OperationChangeInfo.operations`, and test a deferred named callback.
